description: This file contains the implementation of a Stream subclass, OrleansRelationalDownloadStream, which provides chunked reading capabilities over a database column using an ADO.NET DbDataReader. It is designed to facilitate streaming data from a relational database in scenarios where native stream support is unavailable.

classes.name: OrleansRelationalDownloadStream
classes.description: A stream implementation that reads data chunk-by-chunk from a database column via DbDataReader, providing asynchronous and synchronous reading capabilities.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a sequence of bytes from the current stream and advances the position within the stream.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a sequence of bytes from the current stream.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies bytes from the current stream to a destination stream in chunks.
